items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 72:1
items.html: Its source is in the ten Sefirot of AVI. For the Bina of AVI turns her back to Chochma, not wishing to receive Chochma, in the secret of “for He desires kindness,” and therefore she turns her face to draw the light of Hassadim from the Keter, as explained in Part One. Hence the level of Bina, too, chooses to receive only the light of Hassadim and not Chochma, and it is known that Atik is the root for the bestowal of Hassadim, and AA is the root for the bestowal of Chochma. Necessarily, then, Bina must draw her flow from Atik, and not from AA. (Inner Observation, item 10, Sub Header, “And You Shall Understand”)
